messages:
tara: Quick check — promoting Priya IC -> Staff IC, ~18% uplift, asking retro to start of quarter. Also cross-border move CA -> UK. Payroll cutoff Fri EOD. Can we realistically get comp + retro in this run?

kevin: Hi @tara — possible but there are a few gates. Step 1: open the promotions intake form and paste a compact evidence block. If change >15% this routes to comp-review committee (3-5 business days). If you need it expedited mark the intake with 'business-critical' and include a one-line justification. Link: https://redwood.internal/hr/promotions-intake

lena: UK specifics: set tax_jurisdiction=UK on the HRIS ticket, attach P45 if they have one, and NI number when available. Relocation approvals and any gross-up requests must be attached. Note: retro pay will be taxed in the period it's paid; UK uses cumulative coding so payroll will compute tax. Retro beyond 6 months requires exec signoff.

hr-ops-bot: payroll reminder: payroll bundle closes in ~12 hours (2245630000). Submissions after cutoff will be processed next cycle.

kevin: For equity: create a grant request to stock-admin after intake is approved. Stock-admin SLA is usually 7-10 business days once they have full approvals. If you need grant before offer, add a business justification and cc stock-admin on the intake.

tara: Copying the evidence block I'll paste into the form now — shortening to what you asked for: ```
- 2 bullets: measurable impact + project ownership
- New responsibilities mapped to Staff rubric (link to rubric)
- Market comp snapshot (1-pg) attached
- Manager approval: tara@redwood.com
- Relocation note: CA->UK, relocation approved by mobility
```

lena: Also include preferred effective date (we prefer month start) and retro window (e.g., 2026-01-01 -> effective_date). If comp change >15% finance will need to sign off — cc finance@redwood.com. If you want payroll to withhold differently for retro, say 'manual-retro-calc' in the intake.

kevin: I'll cc finance and add comp-review to the intake once you submit. If you tag 'business-critical' I'll triage it immediately.

tara: Filing now. If cutoff looks tight I'll ping y'all in-thread. Thanks! :thumbsup:
